description: This file contains test cases for the React Native project templates, including fixtures for temporary directories, mock configurations, and tests for template initialization, project setup, content replacements, and execution of post-processing scripts.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates and cleans up a temporary directory for tests.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory with configuration and template files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates and provides a mock project configuration object for testing.

methods.name: test_reactnative_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests retrieval of initial template information, verifying configuration values.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the process of initializing a project and verifying the output files and content replacement.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures that post-processing scripts are executed properly, such as creating marker files.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks loading of project config from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that template variables in files are correctly replaced with project parameters.
